text_block_list.text:
I happen to pass by the outdoor stage
after
training, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for droppin' by today, Grass and
Spe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
There's no need to thank us. So, what's
the
occasion?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: You said you had something to show us?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hehehe... Why, I'm glad you asked!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I could give you the answer, but a true
entertainer
communicates on the stage!
Now, feast your eyes
on this special
performance!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Uh... El?! Where did she—
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: CAAAAAWWWWW!
text_block_list.name: Mambo

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why is a bird here?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Well, wouldn't you know? It's El's pet
hawk,
Mambo.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
A h-hawk?! I heard that El had a pet
condor...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Grass! Spe! You shouldn't let your
guards down!
For now, I am over
HEEEEERE!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Whoa! The show's started?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Uno! For your appetizer, we're tossing
up our
favorite judo throws! So fresh and
fantastic!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Caw! ♪ Caaaaawww! ♪
text_block_list.name: Mambo

text_block_list.text: Gosh, this does seem awfully fun.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Dos! Grilled fish is off the menu today!
Instead,
enjoy a piledriver that's so well
done it's sizzlin'!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Caw! CAAAAAWWW!
text_block_list.name: Mambo

text_block_list.text: M-Mambo's getting fired up?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Tres! For the main dish, it's a
show-stopping
tornillo! Mash 'em, grate
'em, and stick 'em in a
stew!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Caw! Ca-caw! ♪ Caaaaawww! ♪
text_block_list.name: Mambo

text_block_list.text:
My goodness, this is very exciting. It's
just like a
circus! ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Maravilloso! Now that our full-course
menu is
complete, it's time for everyone
to join in!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All together now! Who's the world's
greatest
Phantom Bird?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Is this perhaps a call-and-response
performance?
In that case...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Put some bass in your
voices—shout it
out loud! Who's the
world's greatest Phantom
Bird?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: E-El Condor... Pasa?!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер and Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
No, no! Your voices gotta match my
passion!
Who's the world's greatest
Phantom Bird?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: EL CONDOR PASAAAAA!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер and Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Sí! I am numero uno! The greatest
luchadora
around—Эль Кондор Паса!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер and Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
That performance got me heated up! I'm
all
sweaty now!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was a wonderful performance.
You truly
connected with your audience.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Gracias, both of you! I've finally found a

performance that's unique to me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm bringing in the lucha spirit, just how
my papi
taught me! Right, Mambo?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: CAAAAAWWWWW! ♪
text_block_list.name: Mambo

text_block_list.text: Hm? What are you all doing at this hour—is that a bird?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Gah! It'll be curtains for me if she finds
out that
Mambo's my pet! Everyone, run!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! I can't just spring into action
just like
that!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh wow, El had my undivided attention.
But it
would be wise to make our escape
now.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Waaaargh?! Wait, El! Graaaaass!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
